title: Drupalcamp South Carolina Coming NOW!
author: Tom Sliker

html:
After several months of planning, the first stand-alone Drupalcamp South Carolina is finally upon us.   We are expecting 60-70 attendees which is not bad considering it is Easter weekend.  

I'm excited about Ryan Szrama's keynote.   I asked him to focus more on Ryan, less on Drupal commerce.  I'm looking forward to hearing his story.  To me Ryan is a great example of how open source can work out for hard-working individuals willing to give their time. 

Steve Burge of OS Training as well as Ryan and Commerce Guys both agreed to do their Pre-camp (Friday) training for FREE-- what a gift to the Columbia, SC Drupal community!   This has generated quite a bit of excitement and activity over the last few days.

For sessions, we have some of the best and brightest minds in the Drupal Community presenting topics in three tracks:   Beginners,   Design / theming / usability, and Development & Performance.  

If you haven't registered yet, come on out and do some Drupal this weekend!  

If you have an interest in Drupal but can't make it to the camp, feel free to join our SC Drupal Meetup group - we meet on the second Monday of each month at IT-oLogy in Columbia.
